scope: Read-only stdlib/source/artifact audit. No PyTorch import, checkpoint deserialization, training, GPU, benchmarks, or research-checkout edits. JSON gate arithmetic and content hashes independently checked; generated sample RMSE not recomputed.
verdict: Preserve image PASS. No source-level oracle/horizon or duplicate optimizer-hook disqualification found. One concrete component-API portability defect remains. No release/default qualification implied.

noise.interpretation: Fixed initialization is independent of evaluation budget; image ends during output-noise warmup. This is not an irreversible acquisition-to-maintenance LR schedule.

source_contract.finding: Image and ring call the same public get_recipe/GANTrainer package; image changes only frozen resource dimensions. Precision uses mean-reduced input-gradient disagreement and flattened normalized accepted parameter motion, with no vector/image branch.
No quality thresholds, target identities, shift steps or evaluation horizons enter precision/game update. Continuous recipes require total_steps=None and trainer does not stop on a horizon.

Serial backward context wraps joint predictor, correction, all nested higher-order graph creation/backward, and precision observation; Python context manager restores caller mode on success/exception. Mode is saved and validated before checkpoint mutation.

Joint update restores preview clocks/optimizer/controller/EMA/RNG state, retains base-gradient Adam moments for secant formulation, updates accepted precision once, and restores checkpoint on exceptions. Generator callback executes once. Critic reference reseed/update follows recorded KA2 decisions at accepted parameters; skipped reference updates remain skipped.

Precision scalars/reference are included in checkpoint; recipe/mode/model/optimizer/RNG validation precedes mutation. Test source covers exact CPU continuation and rollback, one accepted clock, sparse rows and repeated field RNG draws. Audit did not rerun tests.

KA2/K3P sources match pinned public base; native Adam unwrapping avoids the duplicate subclass/base optimizer-step hook regression. Two optimizer invocations per joint update are intentional field evaluations, not duplicate wrapping.

issues.severity: release portability gap; tested trainer unaffected
issues.finding: learning_rate_scales cannot accept the continuous recipe: total_steps=None reaches min(None, horizon_cap) at line462. scale_learning_rates calls it at486. The component helpers also have no controller-state argument, so repairing only the TypeError with constant rates would not implement RP5.
issues.action: Before claiming component-API equivalence, expose or clearly require the same reusable checkpointed precision policy in component loops and verify helper behavior; keep current GANTrainer results.

issues.finding: Frozen declaration incorrectly says no auxiliary losses exist in this pure GAN host. Raw image card has prior_weight=.05 and image_tasks.run_episode adds ParticleRegularizer. Historical public comparator explicitly replaces this with recipe.prior_reg; pinned fa511 public prior_reg=0 and RP5 prior_reg=0, so no public-candidate prior objective was dropped. This is learner regularization, not evidence of omitted task-required auxiliary loss.
issues.action: Preserve immutable artifacts; attach prose correction. Current image_gate.py already narrows its wording. No image rerun or score invalidation is warranted for this sentence.

issues.severity: checkpoint hardening; no observed evidence failure
issues.finding: ReversiblePrecision.load_state_dict validates keys/variant but not scalar types, finite values or counter ranges. A malformed precision state can pass trainer preflight. Saved valid-run state is fully retained; this does not dispute exact replay.
issues.action: Validate precision values if the new policy becomes public release API.

subsequent_recorded_receipts.interpretation: Receipt/source demonstrate a separate continuation script comparing complete original-run step2500 hashes with resumed branches2400→2500 and split2450. No audit-side checkpoint deserialization or reexecution. Replay crosses reopening.

limits: Image600 run contains zero precision closings/reopenings and ends before KA2 first blend at800, so image alone proves neither reversible rate behavior nor long-term critic-controller behavior.
This audit is one frozen image gate, not all22 tasks, stationary/delayed/repeated-change/long-run qualification or an exact K3P comparison.
Exact sample-level image RMSE and checkpoint tensors were not independently recomputed; observation arithmetic, source path, immutable hashes and recorded continuation receipt were audited.
RP5 intentionally enables eager Adam state including device-local counters; this is a declared experimental formulation choice rather than an invisible storage-only change.
